# SwiftA2UIHost

> A Swift package that renders A2UI (Google's declarative agent-UI format, version 1.0) as native SwiftUI in iOS, macOS and visionOS apps. An AI agent sends JSON describing a screen; the app draws it with native views, including its own components. All 18 basic-catalog components and all 14 basic functions, bindings, validation checks, function calls in both directions and mixed catalogs. v0.9 messages are upgraded on decode. Swift 6, zero dependencies.

## When to use it

- A native Apple-platform app shows agent-built UI, generative UI or server-driven agent UI in the A2UI format (`createSurface`, `updateComponents`, `updateDataModel`, `deleteSurface`).
- Not for: MCP Apps HTML (`ui://`, `text/html;profile=mcp-app`): use SwiftMCPAppHost. Not a transport: bring your own SSE, WebSocket or A2A connection.

## Install

```swift
.package(url: "https://github.com/zhaziragaripolla/SwiftA2UIHost.git", from: "1.0.0"),
// products: SwiftA2UIHostUI (SwiftUI), SwiftA2UIHost (protocol and state, no UI)
```

## Minimal integration

```swift
import SwiftA2UIHostUI

let store = A2UISurfaceStore()            // @MainActor, @Observable
var decoder = A2UILineDecoder()
store.apply(decoder.feed(bytesFromAgent)) // JSONL, any chunking

let catalog = A2UICatalog(id: "com.example.app:catalog/1", including: .basic)
    .registering(A2UIComponentSchema(name: "ProductCard", properties: [.init("title", .string, required: true)])) { context in
        if let product = context.props(as: Product.self) { ProductCard(product) }
    }

A2UISurfaceView(store: store, surfaceId: "main", catalogs: [catalog]) { action in
    if let message = action.messageToAgent, let data = try? message.encoded() { send(data) }   // action, callAgentFunction or error
}
store.onMessageToAgent = { message in if let data = try? message.encoded() { send(data) } }          // function responses, errors

// For the agent's prompt and transport metadata:
let manifest = catalog.manifest(version: "1")
manifest.agentInstructions()
manifest.rendererCapabilities   // {"1.0": {"supportedCatalogIds": [...]}}
```

## Key types

- `A2UIMessage`, `A2UILineDecoder`: decoding. `A2UIRendererMessage`: messages back to the agent.
- `A2UISurfaceStore`: all surfaces, actions, `functions`, `onMessageToAgent`, `diagnostics`.
- `A2UISurface`: components, data model, `resolvedTree()`, `resolve`, `failingChecks`.
- `A2UIFunctionRegistry`, `A2UIFunctionDefinition`: built-in and app functions (`.pure` or `.effect`, `allowedCallers`, `requiresUserActivation`).
- `A2UICatalog`, `A2UIComponentSchema`, `A2UICatalogManifest`, `A2UIDowncompiler`: catalogs, versions and fallbacks.
- `A2UISurfaceView`, `A2UIComponentContext`: rendering and custom components (`props(as:)`, `binding(_:)`, `performAction()`).

## Security model

- Agent output is untrusted. `rendererOnly` functions can't be called by the agent; `openUrl` and other activation-only functions run only from a tap.
- Media URLs are filtered (http(s) with a host, data:, same-host relative). Tree size, depth and expression nesting are capped. Bad input is skipped and reported in `diagnostics`.
